summary: Shows using the boolean magic variable `ansible_check_mode` (since 2.1) to skip a task in check mode with `when: not ansible_check_mode` or ignore its errors with `ignore_errors: "{{ ansible_check_mode }}"`.
questions: How do I skip a task when running with --check?
How do I detect in a playbook that it's running in check mode?
How do I ignore errors only during a dry run?

answer_card.title: Skip tasks or ignore errors in check mode
answer_card.answer_md:
Use the magic variable `ansible_check_mode`, which is `True` in check mode (added in 2.1):

```yaml
- name: Skipped in check mode
  ansible.builtin.git:
    repo: ssh://git@github.com/mylogin/hello.git
    dest: /home/mylogin/hello
  when: not ansible_check_mode

- name: Ignore errors in check mode
  ansible.builtin.git:
    repo: ssh://git@github.com/mylogin/hello.git
    dest: /home/mylogin/hello
  ignore_errors: "{{ ansible_check_mode }}"
```
